nodes.name: Configure Inputs
nodes.notes:
EDIT srm_contact_name to match retail_dim_supplier.srmcontactname exactly (Last, First), e.g. Hannigan, Benjamin.
lookback_months defaults to 6 (L6M new SKU launches).
store_country defaults to United States.

parameters.jsCode:
// Build L6M New SKU Ramp Report Card SQL from Configure Inputs.
// Required: srm_contact_name — retail_dim_supplier.srmcontactname (Last, First)
// Optional: lookback_months (default 6), store_country (default United States)
// Patterns match Weekly Supplier Report: brandname=Wayfair, agg_level=WEEKLY.
// v1.1: wires ads (media-prod), review count (csn_review), upcoming promo (eunarta).
// Review acceleration enrollment intentionally paused.

const cfg = $input.first().json;

function escapeSqlString(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
}

function requiredString(value, fieldName) {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim();
  if (!text) throw new Error(`Configure Inputs: set ${fieldName}`);
  return text;
}

const srm = requiredString(cfg.srm_contact_name, 'srm_contact_name');
const lookbackMonths = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(Number(cfg.lookback_months || 6)));
const storeCountry = String(cfg.store_country || 'United States').trim() || 'United States';
const srmEsc = escapeSqlString(srm);
const countryEsc = escapeSqlString(storeCountry);

const sqlQuery = `
-- =============================================================================
-- NEW SKU RAMP REPORT CARD (L6M by SRM)
-- =============================================================================
WITH inputs AS (
  SELECT
    '${srmEsc}' AS srm_contact_name,
    ${lookbackMonths} AS lookback_months,
    '${countryEsc}' AS store_country,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL ${lookbackMonths} MONTH) AS launch_from,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 5 WEEK) AS l30_week_from,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AS latest_complete_week
),

srm_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    d.origsuid AS supplier_id,
    ANY_VALUE(d.origsuname) AS supplier_name,
    ANY_VALUE(d.srmcontactname) AS srm_contact_name,
    ANY_VALUE(d.sumkcname) AS supplier_marketing_category
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_dim_supplier\` AS d
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE d.susiid = 1
    AND d.suid = d.origsuid
    AND LOWER(TRIM(d.srmcontactname)) = LOWER(TRIM(inputs.srm_contact_name))
  GROUP BY d.origsuid
),

-- L6M launches: daily grain for launchdate
launched_skus AS (
  SELECT
    retail_sku_store_date.sku AS sku,
    MIN(retail_sku_store_date.launchdate) AS launch_date,
    ANY_VALUE(retail_sku_store_date.skuname) AS sku_name,
    ANY_VALUE(retail_sku_store_date.clname) AS class_name,
    ANY_VALUE(retail_sku_store_date.mkcname) AS marketing_category,
    ANY_VALUE(srm_suppliers.supplier_id) AS supplier_id,
    ANY_VALUE(srm_suppliers.supplier_name) AS supplier_name,
    ANY_VALUE(srm_suppliers.srm_contact_name) AS srm_contact_name,
    ANY_VALUE(srm_suppliers.supplier_marketing_category) AS supplier_marketing_category
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_sku_store_date\` AS retail_sku_store_date
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(retail_sku_store_date.supplier_struct) AS supplier_struct
  LEFT JOIN \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_dim_supplier\` AS retail_dim_supplier
    ON retail_dim_supplier.supplierkey = supplier_struct.supplierkey
  INNER JOIN srm_suppliers
    ON srm_suppliers.supplier_id = retail_dim_supplier.origsuid
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE retail_sku_store_date.brandname = 'Wayfair'
    AND retail_sku_store_date.styname = inputs.store_country
    AND retail_sku_store_date.launchdate IS NOT NULL
    AND retail_sku_store_date.launchdate >= inputs.launch_from
    AND retail_sku_store_date.date >= inputs.launch_from
  GROUP BY retail_sku_store_date.sku
),

-- L~30 traffic from WEEKLY agg (last 5 complete weeks)
traffic_rows AS (
  SELECT
    retail_sku_store_date.sku AS sku,
    traffic_source.id AS traffic_source_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS week_start,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.skuvisits, 0) AS visits,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.skuconverted, 0) AS converted
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_sku_store_date_agg\` AS retail_sku_store_date
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(retail_sku_store_date.traffic_source) AS traffic_source
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = retail_sku_store_date.sku
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE retail_sku_store_date.brandname = 'Wayfair'
    AND retail_sku_store_date.styname = inputs.store_country
    AND retail_sku_store_date.agg_level = 'WEEKLY'
    AND DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) >= inputs.l30_week_from
    AND DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) <= inputs.latest_complete_week
),

traffic_deduped AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    week_start,
    traffic_source_id,
    ANY_VALUE(visits) AS visits,
    ANY_VALUE(converted) AS converted
  FROM traffic_rows
  GROUP BY sku, week_start, traffic_source_id
),

traffic_l30 AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    SUM(visits) AS visits_l30,
    SUM(converted) AS converted_l30,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(converted), NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0)) AS cvr_l30
  FROM traffic_deduped
  GROUP BY sku
),

-- Peer CVR among this SRM's L6M launches in the same class
class_cvr AS (
  SELECT
    launched_skus.class_name,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(traffic_l30.converted_l30), NULLIF(SUM(traffic_l30.visits_l30), 0)) AS class_cvr_l30,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(traffic_l30.visits_l30, 100)[OFFSET(25)] AS class_visits_p25
  FROM launched_skus
  LEFT JOIN traffic_l30
    ON traffic_l30.sku = launched_skus.sku
  GROUP BY launched_skus.class_name
),

-- Availability (Weekly Supplier Report unnest path), last 5 weeks
availability_rows AS (
  SELECT
    retail_sku_store_date.sku AS sku,
    DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS week_start,
    retail_ops.id AS ops_id,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(retail_ops_dims.program) NOT IN ('CASTLEGATE', 'DROPSHIP')
      THEN COALESCE(availability_global_num, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END AS availability_num,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(retail_ops_dims.program) NOT IN ('CASTLEGATE', 'DROPSHIP')
      THEN COALESCE(availability_global_denom, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END AS availability_denom
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_sku_store_date_agg\` AS retail_sku_store_date
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(retail_sku_store_date.supplier_struct) AS supplier_struct
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(supplier_struct.supplier_part_struct) AS supplier_part_struct
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(supplier_part_struct.opdimensions) AS retail_ops_dims
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(supplier_part_struct.ops) AS retail_ops
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = retail_sku_store_date.sku
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE retail_sku_store_date.brandname = 'Wayfair'
    AND retail_sku_store_date.styname = inputs.store_country
    AND retail_sku_store_date.agg_level = 'WEEKLY'
    AND DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) >= inputs.l30_week_from
    AND DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) <= inputs.latest_complete_week
),

availability_deduped AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    week_start,
    ops_id,
    MAX(availability_num) AS availability_num,
    MAX(availability_denom) AS availability_denom
  FROM availability_rows
  GROUP BY sku, week_start, ops_id
),

availability_l30 AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(availability_num), NULLIF(SUM(availability_denom), 0)) AS availability_l30
  FROM availability_deduped
  GROUP BY sku
),

-- Latest complete week WSI28D
wsi_rows AS (
  SELECT
    retail_sku_store_date.sku AS sku,
    wpi_wsi.id AS wpi_wsi_id,
    COALESCE(wpi_wsi.WSI28D_Numerator, 0) AS wsi_num,
    COALESCE(wpi_wsi.WSI28D_Denominator, 0) AS wsi_denom
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_sku_store_date_agg\` AS retail_sku_store_date
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(retail_sku_store_date.supplier_struct) AS supplier_struct
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(supplier_struct.wpi_wsi) AS wpi_wsi
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = retail_sku_store_date.sku
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE retail_sku_store_date.brandname = 'Wayfair'
    AND retail_sku_store_date.styname = inputs.store_country
    AND retail_sku_store_date.agg_level = 'WEEKLY'
    AND DATE_TRUNC(retail_sku_store_date.date, WEEK(SUNDAY)) = inputs.latest_complete_week
),

wsi_l28 AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(wsi_num), NULLIF(SUM(wsi_denom), 0)) AS wsi_l28
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sku,
      wpi_wsi_id,
      ANY_VALUE(wsi_num) AS wsi_num,
      ANY_VALUE(wsi_denom) AS wsi_denom
    FROM wsi_rows
    GROUP BY sku, wpi_wsi_id
  )
  GROUP BY sku
),

wsc_l28 AS (
  SELECT
    opc.PrSKU AS sku,
    SUM(COALESCE(opc.ProductCostNoRebates, 0)) AS wsc_l28
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-retail-prod.cm_reporting.retail_fact_order_product_revenue_cost\` AS opc
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = opc.PrSKU
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE opc.SoID = 49
    AND opc.OrderDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
  GROUP BY opc.PrSKU
),

-- Ads: Partner Home insights warehouse (media-prod reporting_service)
-- Spend/ROAS L30; is_advertised = any spend. optimized_l28 left null (no campaign-edit SoT yet).
ads_raw AS (
  SELECT
    ads.prsku AS sku,
    SUM(COALESCE(ads.spend, 0)) AS ad_spend_l30,
    SUM(COALESCE(ads.view_direct_attr.attributed_wholesale_sales, 0)) AS attributed_wsc_l30
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-media-prod.reporting_service.advertising_sku_report_performance_with_attribution_v2\` AS ads
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = ads.prsku
  CROSS JOIN inputs
  WHERE ads.time_dimension = 'DAY'
    AND DATE(ads.report_timestamp_utc) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY ads.prsku
),
ads_l30 AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    ad_spend_l30,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(attributed_wsc_l30, NULLIF(ad_spend_l30, 0)) AS ad_roas_l30,
    ad_spend_l30 > 0 AS is_advertised,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOL) AS optimized_l28
  FROM ads_raw
),

-- Review count / rating (UGC summary). Review acceleration enrollment paused for v1.1.
reviews AS (
  SELECT
    prvs.PrvsPrSKU AS sku,
    prvs.PrvsRatingCount AS review_count,
    prvs.PrvsRating AS avg_rating,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOL) AS in_review_program
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-bulk-prod.csn_review.tbl_product_review_summary\` AS prvs
  INNER JOIN launched_skus
    ON launched_skus.sku = prvs.PrvsPrSKU
),

-- Next open Wayfair US promo period (BrandCatalog_ID = 1) within 90 days
upcoming_promo_periods AS (
  SELECT
    eng.PromoPeriodId AS promo_period_id,
    ANY_VALUE(eng.PromoPeriodName) AS promo_name,
    MIN(DATE(eng.PromoStartDate)) AS promo_start,
    MAX(DATE(eng.PromoEndDate)) AS promo_end
  FROM \`wf-gcp-us-ae-eunarta-prod.reporting.tbl_promo_parts_engagement\` AS eng
  WHERE eng.BrandCatalog_ID = 1
    AND DATE(eng.PromoStartDate) > CURRENT_DATE()
    AND DATE(eng.PromoStartDate) <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
  GROUP BY eng.PromoPeriodId
),
next_promo AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM upcoming_promo_periods
  ORDER BY promo_start
  LIMIT 1
),
promo_flags AS (
  SELECT
    launched_skus.sku AS sku,
    LOGICAL_OR(
      eng.SKU IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(eng.Discount_Status, '')) = 'ACTIVE'
    ) AS in_upcoming_promo,
    ANY_VALUE(next_promo.promo_name) AS upcoming_promo_name
  FROM launched_skus
  LEFT JOIN next_promo
    ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN \`wf-gcp-us-ae-eunarta-prod.reporting.tbl_promo_parts_engagement\` AS eng
    ON eng.SKU = launched_skus.sku
   AND eng.PromoPeriodId = next_promo.promo_period_id
   AND eng.BrandCatalog_ID = 1
  GROUP BY launched_skus.sku
)

SELECT
  launched_skus.srm_contact_name,
  launched_skus.supplier_id,
  launched_skus.supplier_name,
  launched_skus.supplier_marketing_category,
  launched_skus.sku,
  launched_skus.sku_name,
  launched_skus.class_name,
  launched_skus.marketing_category,
  CAST(launched_skus.launch_date AS STRING) AS launch_date,
  DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), launched_skus.launch_date, DAY) AS days_since_launch,
  COALESCE(traffic_l30.visits_l30, 0) AS visits_l30,
  COALESCE(traffic_l30.converted_l30, 0) AS converted_l30,
  traffic_l30.cvr_l30,
  class_cvr.class_cvr_l30,
  class_cvr.class_visits_p25,
  availability_l30.availability_l30,
  wsi_l28.wsi_l28,
  wsc_l28.wsc_l28,
  ads_l30.ad_spend_l30,
  ads_l30.ad_roas_l30,
  ads_l30.is_advertised,
  ads_l30.optimized_l28,
  reviews.review_count,
  reviews.avg_rating,
  reviews.in_review_program,
  promo_flags.in_upcoming_promo,
  promo_flags.upcoming_promo_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM launched_skus) AS universe_sku_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM srm_suppliers) AS universe_supplier_count
FROM launched_skus
LEFT JOIN traffic_l30 ON traffic_l30.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN class_cvr ON class_cvr.class_name = launched_skus.class_name
LEFT JOIN availability_l30 ON availability_l30.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN wsi_l28 ON wsi_l28.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN wsc_l28 ON wsc_l28.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN ads_l30 ON ads_l30.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN reviews ON reviews.sku = launched_skus.sku
LEFT JOIN promo_flags ON promo_flags.sku = launched_skus.sku
ORDER BY COALESCE(traffic_l30.visits_l30, 0) DESC, launched_skus.supplier_name, launched_skus.sku
`;

return [{
  json: {
    srm_contact_name: srm,
    lookback_months: lookbackMonths,
    store_country: storeCountry,
    sqlQuery,
  },
}];

nodes.name: Build Ramp SQL
nodes.notes: Builds one BigQuery SQL for L6M launches + recipe metrics. Ads: media-prod advertising_sku_report_performance_with_attribution_v2. Reviews: csn_review.tbl_product_review_summary (count/rating only; enrollment paused). Promos: next BrandCatalog_ID=1 period in tbl_promo_parts_engagement.

nodes.notes: Applies New SKU Playbook green/red thresholds and builds Summary Action Plan copy.
